## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A principal receives notifications only for events above their configured...

The system SHALL ensure that a principal receives notifications only for events above their configured threshold; the remainder appear in their next digest.

#### Scenario: A principal receives notifications only for events above their configured...

WHEN `attention-budgets-digests` is implemented
THEN A principal receives notifications only for events above their configured threshold; the remainder appear in their next digest.

### Requirement: Digest cadence is configurable per principal and a digest lists every...

The system SHALL ensure that digest cadence is configurable per principal and a digest lists every below-threshold event since the previous digest.

#### Scenario: Digest cadence is configurable per principal and a digest lists every...

WHEN `attention-budgets-digests` is implemented
THEN Digest cadence is configurable per principal and a digest lists every below-threshold event since the previous digest.

### Requirement: With no per-principal configuration, notification behavior is unchanged from...

The system SHALL ensure that with no per-principal configuration, notification behavior is unchanged from today.

#### Scenario: With no per-principal configuration, notification behavior is unchanged from...

WHEN `attention-budgets-digests` is implemented
THEN With no per-principal configuration, notification behavior is unchanged from today.
